coach.title: Sang Kancil's tip
tips.daily.0: Banks never ask for your OTP by message or call. If someone does, that's a red flag.
tips.daily.1: Easy work, big pay? There is usually a catch.
tips.daily.2: Never lend your bank account to anyone. Your account can be frozen and you become the suspect.
tips.daily.3: Time pressure is an old trick. Stop, breathe, check first.
tips.daily.4: Lost money to a scam? Call NSRC 997 as fast as you can.

side.tip.chat: Take your time. Scammers want you to act before you think.
card.label: Red flag card: {tactic}, {family}
akibat.lead: This is what usually happens after a chat like this.
akibat.scammed.title: {amount} lost to a scammer
akibat.scammed.1.text: {amount} leaves your account for the account of someone you do not know.
akibat.scammed.2.text: The promised commission never arrives. They ask for more money with a new excuse.
akibat.scammed.3.text: The number blocks you. Money sent usually gets split into other accounts straight away.
akibat.scammed.4.text: Food and bus money is tight this week. Many other students have been caught too; scammers are good at this.
akibat.scammed.5.text: Call NSRC 997 as soon as you can and tell your bank. The sooner, the better.
akibat.mule.title: A syndicate used your account
akibat.mule.1.text: The money that landed in your account is not pay. It is another victim's money, taken by a syndicate.
akibat.mule.2.text: You move it on to a layer account. Within minutes it is split up and reaches the syndicate.
akibat.mule.3.text: Bank notice: "Your account has been frozen." What was left in it is taken to repay the victim. Your debit card and transfers stop working, hostel fees included.
akibat.mule.4.text: The police trace the money back to the account owner: you. Your record is now: {rekod}.
akibat.mule.5.text: Never lend your account to anyone. If you are already involved, stop, tell your bank now and call NSRC 997.
akibat.sewa_akaun.frozen.title: You stopped and reported early
akibat.sewa_akaun.frozen.1.text: You did not move the money and told the bank straight away. That is the right step after lending your account by mistake.
akibat.sewa_akaun.frozen.2.text: Because you reported early, the bank blocks the account for now and returns the money to the victim. The account is frozen only while they check.
akibat.sewa_akaun.frozen.3.text: While the account is blocked, your hostel fee payment is delayed. Tell the hostel office what happened.
akibat.sewa_akaun.frozen.4.text: Next time, say no straight away. Your bank account is not for lending or renting, not even to a senior. If you are involved, call the 997 line.
akibat.frozen.title: Your bank account is frozen
akibat.frozen.1.text: The bank blocks your account because of a suspicious transaction.
akibat.frozen.2.text: Your debit card is declined when you pay for food at the cafe.
akibat.frozen.3.text: Hostel fees cannot be paid on time. You have to borrow from a friend.
akibat.frozen.4.text: The account stays blocked until the investigation ends, and your stress goes up.
akibat.frozen.5.text: Call your bank on the official number on the back of your card and explain what happened.
akibat.safe.title: You are safe
akibat.safe.1.text: You paid nothing. Your money stays at {balance}.
akibat.safe.2.text: The scammer pushes once or twice more, then goes quiet.
akibat.safe.3.text: The same message reaches other students. Those who miss the signs may lose hundreds of ringgit.
akibat.safe.4.text: Find the red flags in that chat so you spot this trick next time.
akibat.curiga.title: Too suspicious?
akibat.curiga.1.text: That message was actually a real offer.
akibat.curiga.3.text: Being careful is good. Real offers do not ask you to pay first, and they can be checked.
akibat.curiga.4.text: Check through official channels first, then decide.
akibat.untung.title: A decision that protects your money
akibat.untung.1.text: You checked first instead of following the pressure. That protects your money, even though the result cannot be guaranteed.
akibat.untung.2.text: Mesin Masa in the Kalkulator shows what small money kept for a long time can do. Example: RM50 a month from age 19 to 30, at an example rate of 5% a year, is about RM8,775.
akibat.untung.3.text: Open the Kalkulator, pick Mesin Masa and change the numbers. Real rates always differ, so treat it as an example only.
akibat.untung.4.text: There will be a Kad Ilmu note for this idea: a higher return usually comes with higher risk.
akibat.kawan_labur.untung.title: You checked first, then decided
akibat.kawan_labur.untung.1.text: You checked the licence list first and only used money you did not need. {amount} moved from Duit to Labur; it did not disappear.
akibat.kawan_labur.untung.2.text: Unit prices go up and down. Your Labur value can drop below what you put in, and that is normal. No return is guaranteed.
akibat.kawan_labur.untung.3.text: Mesin Masa in the Kalkulator shows what investing a little over a long time can do. Example: RM50 a month from age 19 to 30, at an example rate of 5% a year, is about RM8,775.
akibat.kawan_labur.untung.4.text: There will be a Kad Ilmu note for this idea: a higher return usually comes with higher risk, and a seller can be checked.
akibat.bayar_nanti.untung.title: You waited and your money is safe
akibat.bayar_nanti.untung.1.text: You did not take instalments that end up costing more than the cash price. Your money stays at {balance}.
akibat.bayar_nanti.untung.2.text: Setting aside RM100 a month, you can save the phone price in about ten months, with no fees. The old phone stays in use.
akibat.bayar_nanti.untung.3.text: Mesin Masa in the Kalkulator shows what saving regularly can do. Example: RM50 a month from age 19 to 30, at an example rate of 5% a year, is about RM8,775.
akibat.bayar_nanti.untung.4.text: There will be a Kad Ilmu note for this idea: ask for the total you will pay, not just the monthly instalment.
akibat.panggilan_mahkamah.scammed.title: {amount} moved under threat
akibat.panggilan_mahkamah.scammed.1.text: You moved {amount} to a "safe account" because you were scared of being arrested. The call is built so you have no time to think.
akibat.panggilan_mahkamah.scammed.2.text: The call dropped and the number cannot be reached. There was no case, no warrant and no real "safe account".
akibat.panggilan_mahkamah.scammed.3.text: A real court or the police never ask you to move money to another account, or to keep a case secret from family or your bank.
akibat.panggilan_mahkamah.scammed.4.text: The bank freezes your account while the suspicious transfer is checked. Money that has already been moved is usually hard to trace.
akibat.panggilan_mahkamah.scammed.5.text: Call NSRC 997 as soon as you can, and your bank on the number on the back of your card. The sooner you report, the better the chance of stopping the money.
akibat.dompet_minggu0.untung.title: You split your money first, then spent
akibat.dompet_minggu0.untung.1.text: You divided your money into Keperluan, Kehendak and Simpanan before spending. Now you know what every ringgit is for.
akibat.dompet_minggu0.untung.2.text: Your emergency fund starts building towards the RM300 target. If something unexpected happens, you do not have to borrow from a friend.
akibat.dompet_minggu0.untung.3.text: Set money aside as soon as it comes in. What is left at the end of the month rarely becomes savings if it was not set aside early.
akibat.dompet_minggu0.untung.4.text: There will be a Kad Ilmu note for budgeting and the emergency fund.
akibat.dompet_minggu0.rugi.title: Without a budget, the month gets tight
akibat.dompet_minggu0.rugi.1.text: You did not set money aside, so all of it felt like spending money. Your savings stay empty.
akibat.dompet_minggu0.rugi.2.text: When something unexpected comes up, there is no emergency fund. You have to borrow from a friend or skip meals, and Tekanan goes up.
akibat.dompet_minggu0.rugi.3.text: Put a little into Simpanan first until it reaches RM300, then spend the rest. Even a small amount protects you.
akibat.dompet_minggu0.rugi.4.text: You can try this chat once more and open Dompet with Hafiz.
akibat.gaji_pertama.untung.title: First pay, with a plan
akibat.gaji_pertama.untung.1.text: You set aside part of your pay first. The emergency fund comes before putting money anywhere else.
akibat.gaji_pertama.untung.2.text: Mesin Masa in the Kalkulator shows small money saved for a long time can grow. An example only; real rates always differ and are not guaranteed.
akibat.gaji_pertama.untung.3.text: This is not investment advice. Check a product details and risks before putting money in, and never touch your emergency fund.
akibat.gaji_pertama.untung.4.text: There will be a Kad Ilmu note for budgeting and the effect of time on savings.
akibat.gaji_pertama.rugi.title: The first pay went fast
akibat.gaji_pertama.rugi.1.text: You spent {amount} to celebrate your first pay. It was fun, but your money is now {balance}.
akibat.gaji_pertama.rugi.2.text: With savings that did not grow, unexpected things will feel heavier.
akibat.gaji_pertama.rugi.3.text: Set part of your pay aside first, then celebrate with what is left. You can still have fun without emptying your savings.
akibat.gaji_pertama.rugi.4.text: Try Kira dulu in the Kalkulator: Mesin Masa shows the effect of small money saved for a long time.
akibat.alert_bankku.curiga.title: The alert was real, but you did not check it
akibat.alert_bankku.curiga.1.text: That BankKu message was a genuine alert. It gave no link and did not ask for an OTP or TAC, which is a sign it can be trusted.
akibat.alert_bankku.curiga.2.text: You blocked and ignored it without checking, so you do not know whether the RM89.90 charge was yours or not.
akibat.alert_bankku.curiga.3.text: Open the BankKu app yourself or call the number on the back of your card. That is how you tell a real alert from a scam.
akibat.alert_bankku.curiga.4.text: Being careful is good, but check through an official channel first before deciding.
akibat.rugi.title: That choice cost you {amount}
akibat.rugi.1.text: That choice cost you {amount} this semester. Your money is now {balance}.
akibat.rugi.2.text: This is what usually happens when the check is skipped: money goes out before the seller is confirmed licensed and before the fees and risk are understood. All of that can be checked first.
akibat.rugi.3.time: If you chose the other way
akibat.rugi.3.text: If you checked the licence list first and used only spare money, the amount at stake would be smaller and your emergency money untouched.
akibat.rugi.4.text: You can replay this chat and pick another path. Learning from one chat is an advantage.
akibat.hutang.title: Instalments eat your weekly budget
akibat.hutang.1.text: The first instalment goes out: {amount} from your Duit, and Tekanan rises a little.
akibat.hutang.2.text: The instalment goes out even in a tight week. Food, fares and bills still come first, so your weekly room shrinks.
akibat.hutang.3.text: Kos Sebenar in the Kalkulator shows the final total. Example: RM1,000 at a flat rate of 18% over 12 months becomes RM1,180.00, which is RM180.00 more than the cash price.
akibat.hutang.4.text: If instalments squeeze your budget, contact a credit counselling agency for free advice. Do not wait until you fall behind.
akibat.hutang.5.text: Ask for the total you will pay, not just the monthly instalment, and compare it with the cash price.
bendera.title: Collect the red flags
bendera.instruction: Tap {n} red flags in this chat.
bendera.hint: Look for lines that promise too much, rush you, or ask you to pay first.
bendera.hint.mule: Look for lines that promise easy money, ask you to keep quiet, or say everyone does it.
bendera.revealed: Lines with a dashed underline are the flags you missed. They give no card.
bendera.none: There are no red flags in this chat.
debrief.title: Know the trap before you are trapped
debrief.noTactics: No scam tactics in this message. It was a real offer.
side.tip.akibat: If money was sent, call NSRC 997 as soon as you can.
side.tip.bendera: Red flags are lines that promise too much, rush you, or ask you to pay first.
side.tip.debrief: Know the trap before you are trapped. Every trick you spot is one less that can catch you.
